criteria.text: `src/ui/render.ts` contains no literal `word-button`, `word-glow`, `word-hit`, or `class="word"` string; the atlas word markup uses `atlas-word`/`atlas-glow`/`atlas-hit`/`atlas-text` instead, and `test/render.test.ts` (`data-person-docs` guard, currently matching `class="word-button"`) is updated to match `atlas-word`.

No glow or hit `<rect>` emitted by any of the three builders carries an `rx` attribute; `public/atlas.css` sets `rx` in the `.atlas-glow`/`.atlas-hit`/`.ruler-glow`/`.ruler-hit`/`.week-glow`/`.week-hit` rules, at the same values as today (9/6 for atlas, 8/5 for ruler and week).

The ruler's word markup wraps its text in a `<tspan x="0" y="0">` exactly like the atlas and week do; `test/render.test.ts`'s ruler assertions (currently `>${word}</text>`) are updated to `>${word}</tspan>`, and a run of `pnpm test` shows every existing ruler/week/atlas markup assertion green with the new class names and tag shape.
`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` all exit 0, and `public/bundle.js` is committed in the same change (`test/bundle-freshness.test.ts` passes).

`git diff public/atlas.css` for this change touches only the three renamed rule blocks (selector names, added `rx` declarations) — no new colour, size or spacing token, and no `font-size` written as a raw px value (`test/leitura-ui-acceptance.test.ts` stays green).

Manual check: loading `public/design-5.html` locally and opening figures 1, 3 and 5 shows glow/hit halos and rounded corners visually unchanged from `master`, and clicking a word in each figure still toggles selection and opens `#docsDialog` as before.
No file adds or renames a `wordMark` export; `src/ui/marks.ts` still exports only `frame`, `axis`, `overflowList`, and `test/marks.test.ts`'s existing suite for those three passes unmodified.
